title: Argentinian Keto Beef Wrap
description: A flavorful, low-carb take on a classic beef wrap, featuring juicy beef, fresh herbs, and a tangy sauce.

ingredients.name: Rustic sourdough wrap
ingredients.notes: Note: To remain keto, use a low-carb wrap or substitute with a portobello mushroom cap.

ingredients.name: Argentinian chimichurri
ingredients.notes: Make your own by combining parsley, oregano, garlic, red pepper flakes, red wine vinegar, and olive oil.

instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the beef with salt and pepper.
Grill the beef for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 135°F (57°C) for medium-rare.
Let the beef rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
Warm the wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spread a tablespoon of chimichurri on the wrap.
Place a few slices of beef on the wrap.
Top with cilantro, a squeeze of lime juice, and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
